title: One overall comment → Category-level context
problem: One overall comment could not explain why a specific category received a low rating.
decision: Add an optional comment field alongside each of the five rating dimensions.
benefit: Employees can connect a rating to the feedback behind it.
point: Comments are placed directly below the corresponding rating.

title: Decimal scores → Clearer grades
problem: Scores such as 4.2 and 4.5 invited comparisons instead of constructive interpretation.
decision: Show performance through A+, A, B+ and B grade labels rather than leading with decimal scores.
benefit: Attention shifts from small numerical differences to performance context.
point: The redesigned detail view gives the grade a visible position in the header.

title: Monthly reviews → Quarterly cycles
problem: Monthly submissions repeated administrative work before meaningful progress could be assessed.
decision: Replace month-based review entry with Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4 review periods.
benefit: Team leads get more time to assess progress, with a clearer review timeline.
point: Quarter labels and quarter-specific details replace the earlier month list.

title: Locked submissions → Correctable feedback
problem: Submitted reviews could not be corrected if a rating or comment was entered incorrectly.
decision: Provide an edit path for authorized team leads after submission.
benefit: Corrections can be made without creating a duplicate review.
point: The new feedback list supplies contextual actions for managing each review.
